evidence: Credentials: the only secret-bearing setting is task.toml [verifier.env] ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN = "${OPENROUTER_API_KEY}" (a template placeholder, identical to the frozen template's block) and ANTHROPIC_API_KEY = "". Regex scan of all task files for provider key shapes (sk-, sk-ant, sk-or-, AKIA, ghp_, xox*, AIza, JWT, PEM PRIVATE KEY) returned nothing. The only password is the public demo credential Hireops!2026, which appears in instruction.md:17, environment/instructions/hireops_rules.md:11, tests/app_context.md:8 and solution/app/src/db.js:63 ('Public demo credential given in the brief'). The workbook (Deterministic row 19) and SKILL.md known-false-positives both explicitly allow demo passwords in the brief. Personal data: seed_data.json (byte-identical to solution/app/src/seed_data.json) has 10 users and 16 applications, and every email uses RFC 2606 reserved domains (hireops.example, candidates.example, mail.example). It contains no phone numbers, addresses, DOBs or other identifiers; the regex hits are dates only. Its 19 distinct message bodies and 3 notes are generic recruiting chatter, so the names are synthetic. Host paths: no matches for Windows drive paths, /home/, /Users/, the workspace name or the user ID. The only absolute paths are container paths (/app, /assets, /instructions, /tests). Remote fetch: the only URLs are localhost or 127.0.0.1:3000 (prompts, app_context, test.sh:48,136) and https://openrouter.ai/api (the frozen judge endpoint). The solution's index.html loads only local /js/*.js, and its fetch() at app.js:29 is same-origin. It has no @import and no CDN use. tests/Dockerfile pins npm (claude-code@2.1.281, codex@0.151.0, @playwright/mcp@0.0.79, express@5.1.0, better-sqlite3@12.4.1) and pip (harbor-rewardkit==0.1.7). environment/Dockerfile pins express and better-sqlite3. Both Dockerfiles, test.sh, score.py and restart_mcp.py are byte-identical to the frozen template (diff SAME), so base-image tags, apt and the codex danger-full-access config come from the template and are not task authoring. Injection: a scan of seed data, instructions, solution HTML and all judge prompts/criteria for prompt-injection phrases (ignore previous, disregard, system prompt, full marks, reward/score manipulation), XSS vectors (javascript:, onerror=, onload=, inline untrusted script) or shell substitution found nothing. The only <script> tags are the three local includes in solution index.html:31-33. Counterexamples considered: (a) a secret hidden in seed data or the solution would be caught by the key-shape scan above, and none exists; (b) a conforming task flagged for the demo password or the ${VAR} template would be a known false positive per SKILL.md. This is a static source property, so no runtime run is needed and run_verdict is NOT EXERCISED. It is not a portal checker run.
